thread:
maria: Great AH — thanks all. Follow-up: Dedicated launch readiness, SLAs, onboarding checklist, and owners. TL;DR: GA 2026-08-15, soft-launch invite window, and clear owners. :rocket:
jon: need a concrete GA date for sales comms.
maria: target GA 2026-08-15; soft-launch 8/15–9/15 (invite-only); broad GA 9/16.
diego: SLA numbers?
maria: control-plane 99.95% uptime, data-plane 99.9% availability. Latency p95 target <= 120ms for small-gen on recommended instances. Full table in GA notes.
emily: who owns onboarding docs & terraform examples? also migration from hosted?
tara: product/docs own onboarding + terraform examples. Migration guided flow will let customers pin models and shift traffic gradually.
vikram: infra checklist: VPC peering, route tables, KMS access, firewall rules. I'll publish checklist to #eng-infra.
deploy-bot: task created: "dedicated-ga-checklist" assigned to #eng-platform due 2026-07-20.
maria: action owners (short): 1) GA announcement + comms (tara + marketing) — due 2026-07-30; 2) onboarding docs + terraform (tara + eng-platform) — due 2026-08-01; 3) migration playbook + scripts (diego) — due 2026-08-05; 4) SLA docs & dashboards (vikram + eng-sre) — due 2026-07-25; 5) beta cohort invites (jon) — list by 2026-07-10; 6) billing verification (finance) — by 2026-07-20.
jon: I'll coordinate beta list, target 30 customers for soft-launch.
diego: migration playbook will include a CLI quick-test and traffic-shift snippet.
emily: propose a minimal terraform snippet for docs; I'll draft it.
vikram: monitoring hooks — customers should be able to forward metrics to Datadog/Prometheus; will coordinate with eng-sre.
tara: marketing will prepare a one-pager for sales demos. Draft by 2026-07-25.
emily: who to ping for terraform reviews?
tara: ping @eng-platform (owner: lee) and me.
maria: links: RFC https://redwood.example.com/rfc/dedicated-ga-2026, slides https://slides.redwood.example.com/ah-jun-2026#dedicated, onboarding draft https://docs.redwood.example.com/dedicated/onboarding-draft. I'll open focused threads in #eng-platform and #eng-infra for workstreams. Thanks! :tada:
